record.summary: The six-story building at 1515 Third Street, the second building of the Uber headquarters campus designed by SHoP Architects (per ArchDaily) and developed by a joint venture of Alexandria Real Estate Equities and Uber formed in September 2014; the Assessor roll gives 6 stories, 302,084 sq ft and 2021 as year built, the Department of Building Inspection shows its new-construction permit completed on 2021-04-01, and OpenAI leases it with 1455 Third Street (Uber, October 2023).

facts.value: Joint venture of Alexandria Real Estate Equities (51%) and Uber Technologies (49%), formed September 2014, per Alexandria's 3Q14 report
SHoP Architects (ArchDaily lists the project year as 2022)
6 on the Assessor roll and in ArchDaily ('a six-story structure at 1515 Third Street'); the permit proposed 7 stories
302,084 (Assessor roll property_area); 422,980 rentable sq ft for 1455 and 1515 Third Street together (Alexandria, 2014)
$125.0 million purchase price for both parcels (1455/1515 Third Street) including 423 parking structure spaces, foundation piles, plans and permits; not split by building
OpenAI leases 1455 and 1515 Third St from Uber (October 2023)

record.notes: 1515 3rd St, one of the two buildings of Uber's Mission Bay headquarters campus (1455 and 1515 3rd St) -- a 6-story, 302,084 sq ft office building (DataSF Assessor tax roll figures; year built 2021 per the Assessor, 2022 per ArchDaily's project page), designed by SHoP Architects and developed in a partnership between Uber and Alexandria Real Estate Equities (SocketSite, Sept 2016; ArchDaily names SHoP). Reported in October 2023 to be subleased to OpenAI along with 1455 3rd St (The Real Deal, SF Standard). Uber's FY2025 annual report (10-K) gives its principal executive offices as 1725 3rd St, not 1515.
